scripts.build:server: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && go build -o build/bin/jotter-server main_server.go shared_assets.go
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: go test -coverprofile=coverage.out -coverpkg=./internal/... $(go list -f '{{if or .TestGoFiles .XTestGoFiles}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' ./internal/... ./tests/...) && cd frontend && npm run test:coverage && cd .. && node scripts/combine-coverage.js
scripts.lint:backend:fix: echo "No automatic linter fix for Go backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend:fix && npm run lint:frontend:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:backend:check && npm run format:frontend:check
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && go mod download
